CustomField.description: Is a REAL form required? Yes or No response required. Checkbox for: "Does this complaint relate/create a COR event/Compliance Incident"
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A REAL form is required if there has been an Operational Risk Event: a failure of internal process, people and/or systems, or from an external event. Note: Ticking this box does not automatically generate a REAL form. If a REAL form is required, it will need to be submitted by following your Businesses BAU process. For assistance, search: ‘REAL form’ on MAX or speak with your Line Manager.
CustomField.label: Is a REAL form required?
